name: agentic-rail
title: Agentic Rail Chain
description: Agentic payments protocol comparison > AP2 mandate > Visa TAP signature inspection > Mastercard agentic token scope > A2A agent card validation > x402 payload decode > x402 settlement modelling > MCP developer readiness scorecard. The composer page routes the comparator into a card branch and an A2A branch that converge on the readiness scorecard; the chain records that run in the linear order the page renders, because a chain has no branch construct. The sibling chain agentic-rail-standards is the standards-only check over the card-network token specifications and shares no step with this one: this chain runs the protocol end to end, that one checks conformance with the published standards.

steps.handoff: Root — routes to Branch A (AP2/Card) or Branch B (A2A/x402); converges at ART-18
Branch A A1 — AP2 payment mandate; feeds ART-23 Visa TAP
Branch A A2 — Visa TAP compliance control; feeds ART-24
Branch A A3 terminal — Mastercard agentic token scope; then ART-18
Branch B B1 — A2A agent card compliance; feeds ART-26
Branch B B2 — x402 payload decode and lint; feeds ART-03
Branch B B3 terminal — x402 settlement cost and finality; then ART-18
Terminal — both branches converge; final agentic-rail compliance mandate
